01

“who created you from one soul”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:1).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
who created you from one soul [al-Nisa 1], meaning: from Adam, and created from it its mate [al-Nisa 1], He says: "He created Eve from Adam's short rib while he was asleep; he awoke and said, 'atha,' meaning 'woman,' in Nabatean."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلُهُ:
الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ [النساء: 1] يَعْنِي: مِنْ آدَمَ "، وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا [النساء: 1] ، يَقُولُ: " خَلَقَ حَوَّاءَ مِنْ قُصَيْرِيِّ آدَمَ وَهُوَ نَائِمٌ فَاسْتَيْقَظَ، فَقَالَ: أثا يَعْنِي امْرَأَةً وَهِيَ بِالنَّبَطِيَّةِ "
Edition record 371948 · p. 265Link to report ↗
02

“and do not exchange the wicked for the good”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:2).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and do not exchange the wicked for the good [al-Nisa 2]: He says: "Do not exchange the unlawful from the orphans' wealth for the lawful from your own wealth."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ
وَلَا تَتَبَدَّلُوا الْخَبِيثَ بِالطَّيِّبِ [النساء: 2] يَقُولُ: «لَا تَتَبَدَّلُوا الْحَرَامَ مِنْ أَمْوَالِ الْيَتَامَى بِالْحَلَالِ مِنْ أَمْوَالِكُمْ»
Edition record 371949 · p. 265Link to report ↗
03

“And if you fear that you will not deal justly with the orphans”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:3).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And if you fear that you will not deal justly with the orphans [al-Nisa 3]: He says: "If you feel scruple about taking charge of the orphans' wealth out of faith and belief, then what you do in gathering women is greater"; then marry those that please you of women, two or three or four [al-Nisa 3]: He says: "and likewise, be scrupulous about fornication."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَى [النساء: 3] يَقُولُ: «إِنْ تَحَرَّجْتُمْ مِنْ وَلَايَةِ أَمْوَالِ الْيَتَامَى إِيمَانًا وَتَصْدِيقًا، فَمَا تَأْتُونَ فِي جَمْعِكُمُ النِّسَاءَ أَعْظَمُ» ، فَانْكِحُوا مَا طَابَ لَكُمْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ مَثْنَى وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ [النساء: 3] يَقُولُ: «وَكَذَلِكَ فَتَحَرَّجُوا مِنَ الزِّنَا»
Edition record 371950 · p. 266Link to report ↗

Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
more likely that you will not incline [alla taulu] [al-Nisa 3]: "that you not incline."
العربية

أَدْنَى أَلَّا تَعُولُوا [النساء: 3] «أَلَّا تَمِيلُوا»

04

“the foolish [sufaha]”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Jābir.

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
the foolish [sufaha] [al-Baqara 13], meaning: "women. God, Mighty and Majestic, forbade men to give women their wealth, and they are the foolish, whoever they may be, whether wives, daughters, or mothers; they were commanded to provide for them from it and to speak to them a kind word."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
السُّفَهَاءَ [البقرة: 13] يَعْنِي: " النِّسَاءَ، نَهَى اللَّهُ عز وجل الرِّجَالَ أَنْ يُعْطُوا النِّسَاءَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَهُنَّ السُّفَهَاءُ مَنْ كُنَّ: إِنْ كُنَّ أَزْوَاجًا، أَوْ بَنَاتٍ، أَوْ أُمَّهَاتٍ، فَأُمِرُوا أَنْ يَرْزُقُوهُمْ مِنْهَا وَأَنْ يَقُولُوا لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَعْرُوفًا "
Edition record 371952 · p. 266Link to report ↗
06
Report from Jābir 06

Jābir

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Shayban related to us, from Jabir, who said:
I asked Mujahid about the foolish, and he said: "The foolish: men and women."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ مُجَاهِدًا، عَنِ السُّفَهَاءِ، فَقَالَ:
" السُّفَهَاءُ: مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ "
Edition record 371953 · p. 266Link to report ↗
05

“and test the orphans”

Five explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr, Ibn ʿAbbās, ʿAṭāʾ ibn Abī Rabāḥ and Ibrāhīm (Q 4:6).

07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and test the orphans [al-Nisa 6]: He says: "test their intellects"; until, when they reach marriageable age [al-Nisa 6]: He says: "when they reach puberty."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَابْتَلُوا الْيَتَامَى [النساء: 6] يَقُولُ: «ابْتَلُوا عُقُولَهُمْ» ، حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغُوا النِّكَاحَ [النساء: 6] يَقُولُ: «إِذَا بَلَغُوا الْحُلُمَ»
Edition record 371954 · p. 267Link to report ↗
08
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 08

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Abd al-Ala, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, on His words
and whoever is poor, let him eat in a proper manner [al-Nisa 6], he said: "The guardian of the orphan eats his sustenance from the orphan's wealth, wears from it what covers him, drinks the surplus of milk, and rides the surplus of mounts; if he becomes well-off he repays it, and if he is in hardship he is free of obligation."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ
وَمَنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ [النساء: 6] قَالَ: «يَأْكُلُ وَالِي الْيَتِيمِ مِنْ مَالِ الْيَتِيمِ قُوتَهُ، وَيَلْبَسُ مِنْهُ مَا يَسْتُرُهُ، وَيَشْرَبُ فَضْلَ اللَّبَنِ، وَيَرْكَبُ فَضْلَ الظُّهْرِ، فَإِنْ أَيْسَرَ قَضَاهُ، وَإِنْ أَعْسَرَ كَانَ فِي حِلٍّ»
Edition record 371955 · p. 267Link to report ↗
09
Report from Mujāhid 09

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording

"Eating in a proper manner means as a loan from the wealth of the orphan in his care."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
«أَكَلَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ، يَعْنِي سَلَفًا مِنْ مَالِ يَتِيمِهِ»

ʿAṭāʾ ibn Abī Rabāḥ

06

“And let those fear [God] who, if they left behind weak offspring”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:9).

12
Explanation from Mujāhid 12

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And let those fear [God] who, if they left behind weak offspring [al-Nisa 9], he said: "This concerns the making of a will. Someone present says to him: 'You have given too little; bequeath to so-and-so and the family of so-and-so.' God, Mighty and Majestic, says: Let those present fear, and let them say what they would like to be said to them about their own children later; and let them speak words of appropriate justice [al-Nisa 9]," meaning: "just words."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَلْيَخْشَ الَّذِينَ لَوْ تَرَكُوا مِنْ خَلْفِهِمِ ذُرِّيَّةً ضِعَافًا [النساء: 9] قَالَ: " هَذَا عِنْدَ الْوَصِيَّةِ، فَيَقُولُ لَهُ مَنْ حَضَرَهُ: أَقْلَلْتَ فَأَوْصِ لِفُلَانٍ وَلِآلِ فُلَانٍ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عز وجل: وَلْيَخْشَ أُولَئِكَ وَلْيَقُولُوا كَمَا يُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يُقَالَ لَهُمْ فِي أوْلَادِهِمْ بَعْدُ، وَلْيَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا [النساء: 9] يَعْنِي: «عَدْلًا»
Edition record 371959 · p. 268Link to report ↗
07

“God instructs you concerning your children: for the male, what is…”

Two explanations transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās and Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:11).

13
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 13

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Ata ibn Abi Rabah, from Ibn Abbas, on His words:
God instructs you concerning your children: for the male, what is equal to the share of two females [al-Nisa 11], he said: "Inheritance used to go to the child, and the bequest to the parents and relatives. God, Mighty and Majestic, abrogated of that whatever He wished and gave the male child a share equal to that of two females, gave the parents two sixths, gave the husband a half or a quarter, and gave the wife a quarter or an eighth."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
يُوصِيكُمُ اللَّهُ فِي أَوْلَادِكُمْ لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ [النساء: 11] قَالَ: «كَانَ الْمِيرَاثُ لِلْوَلَدِ، وَالْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ، فَنَسَخَ اللَّهُ عز وجل مِنْ ذَلِكَ مَا أَحَبَّ، فَجَعَلَ لِلْوَلَدِ الذِّكْرِ مِثْلَ حَظِّ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ، وَجَعَلَ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ السُّدُسَيْنِ، وَجَعَلَ لِلزَّوْجِ النِّصْفَ أَوِ الرُّبُعَ، وَجَعَلَ لِلْمَرْأَةِ الرُّبُعَ أَوِ الثَّمَنَ»
Edition record 371960 · p. 268Link to report ↗

English

لَا تَدْرُونَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ لَكُمْ نَفْعًا [النساء: 11] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي فِي الدُّنْيَا»

09

“And those who commit immorality among your women”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:15).

16
Explanation from Mujāhid 16

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And those who commit immorality among your women [al-Nisa 15], meaning: "fornication."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَاللَّاتِي يَأْتِينَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مِنْ نسَائِكُمْ [النساء: 15] يَعْنِي: «الزِّنَا»
Edition record 371963 · p. 269Link to report ↗
17
Explanation from Mujāhid 17

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
or God ordains for them a way [al-Nisa 15], he said: the way is "the penalty."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ:
أَوْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلًا [النساء: 15] قَالَ: السَّبِيلُ: «الْحَدُّ»

“then punish them both”

18
Explanation from Mujāhid 18

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
then punish them both [al-Nisa 16], meaning: "with insult; then it was abrogated by: 'The fornicator and the fornicatress, flog each one of them with a hundred lashes.'"
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ
فَآذُوهُمَا [النساء: 16] يَعْنِي: «سَبًّا، ثُمَّ نَسَخَتْهَا» . الزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِي فَاجْلِدُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ

11

“for those who do evil out of ignorance”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:17).

19
Explanation from Mujāhid 19

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
for those who do evil out of ignorance [al-Nisa 17], he said: "Whoever disobeys his Lord is ignorant, until he gives up the disobedience."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
لِلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ السُّوءَ بِجَهَالَةٍ [النساء: 17] قَالَ: «مَنْ عَصَى رَبَّهُ فَهُوَ جَاهِلٌ حَتَّى يَنْزِعَ عَنِ الْمَعْصِيَةِ»

12

“It is not lawful for you to inherit women by compulsion”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:19).

20
Explanation from Mujāhid 20

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
It is not lawful for you to inherit women by compulsion [al-Nisa 19], he said: "When a man died, his son had more right to his wife." He says: So there was revealed: It is not lawful for you to inherit women by compulsion [al-Nisa 19].
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
لَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَرِثُوا النِّسَاءَ كَرْهًا [النساء: 19] قَالَ: «كَانَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا تُوُفِّيَ كَانَ ابْنُهُ أَحَقَّ بِامْرَأَتِهِ» يَقُولُ فَنَزَلَتْ: لَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَرِثُوا النِّسَاءَ كَرْهًا [النساء: 19]
Edition record 371967 · p. 270Link to report ↗
13

“And if you want to replace one wife with another and you have given…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:20).

21
Explanation from Mujāhid 21

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
And if you want to replace one wife with another and you have given one of them a heap of gold [al-Nisa 20]: He says: "If you want to divorce one woman and marry another, then nothing of the divorced woman's wealth is lawful for you, however much; and that is His words and you have given one of them a heap of gold, do not take from it anything [al-Nisa 20]."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَإِنْ أَرَدْتُمُ اسْتِبْدَالَ زَوْجٍ مَكَانَ زَوْجٍ وَآتَيْتُمْ إِحْدَاهُنَّ قِنْطَارًا [النساء: 20] يَقُولُ: " إِنْ أَرَدْتُمْ طَلَاقَ امْرَأَةٍ وَنِكَاحَ أُخْرَى فَلَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ مِنْ مَالِ الْمُطَلَّقَةِ شَيْءٌ - وَإِنْ كَثُرَ - وَهُوَ قَوْلُهُ وَآتَيْتُمْ إِحْدَاهُنَّ قِنْطَارًا فَلَا تَأْخُذُوا مِنْهُ شَيْئًا [النساء: 20] "
Edition record 371968 · p. 271Link to report ↗
14

“and you have gone in to one another”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:21).

22
Explanation from Mujāhid 22

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and you have gone in to one another [al-Nisa 21], meaning: "intercourse"; and they have taken from you a solemn covenant [al-Nisa 21], he said: "meaning the words of marriage by which the private parts were made lawful."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَقَدْ أَفْضَى بَعْضُكُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ [النساء: 21] يَعْنِي: «الْمُجَامَعَةَ» ، وَأَخَذْنَ مِنْكُمْ مِيثَاقًا غَلِيظًا [النساء: 21] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي كَلِمَةَ النِّكَاحِ الَّتِي اسْتَحَلَّ بِهَا الْفَرْجَ»
Edition record 371969 · p. 271Link to report ↗
15

“and married women, except what your right hands possess”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 4:24).

23
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 23

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Sharik related to us, from Salim al-Aftas, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, on His words:
and married women, except what your right hands possess [al-Nisa 24], he said: "They are the female captives who have husbands; there is no harm in having intercourse with them once they have been cleared of pregnancy." Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Sharik related to us, from Ata ibn al-Saib, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, the same. ⦗p. 272⦘ Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from al-Mughira, from Ibrahim, the same. Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words in wedlock [muhsinin] [al-Nisa 24], meaning: "marrying"; not as fornicators [musafihin] [al-Nisa 24], meaning: "not fornicating with every fornicatress."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ الْأَفْطَسِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَالْمُحْصَنَاتُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانَكُمْ [النساء: 24] قَالَ: «هُنَّ السَّبَايَا الَّتِي لَهُنَّ الْأَزْوَاجُ، فَلَا بَأْسَ بِمُجَامَعَتِهِنَّ إِذَا اسْتَبْرَأْنَ» . أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، مِثْلَهُ، ⦗ص: 272⦘ أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مِثْلَهُ. أَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ مُحْصِنِينَ [النساء: 24] يَعْنِي: «مُتَنَاكِحِينَ» . غَيْرَ مُسَافِحِينَ [النساء: 24] يَعْنِي: «غَيْرَ زَانِينَ بِكُلِّ زَانِيَةٍ»
Edition record 371970 · p. 271Link to report ↗
16

“And whoever among you cannot afford to marry free, believing women”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:25).

24
Explanation from Mujāhid 24

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
And whoever among you cannot afford to marry free, believing women [al-Nisa 25]: He says: "whoever does not find the means to marry free women, meaning the free, let him marry a believing slave woman."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ مِنْكُمْ طَوْلًا أَنْ يَنْكِحَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ [النساء: 25] يَقُولُ: " مَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ غِنًى أَنْ يَنْكِحَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ، يَعْنِي: الْحَرَائِرَ فَلْيَنْكِحِ الْأَمَةَ الْمُؤْمِنَةَ "
Edition record 371971 · p. 272Link to report ↗
25
Explanation from Mujāhid 25

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
nor taking secret lovers [akhdan] [al-Nisa 25], he said: "meaning companions; and that you be patient and abstain from marrying slave women is better for you, though it is lawful."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
وَلَا مُتَّخِذَاتِ أَخْدَانٍ [النساء: 25] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي الْأَخِلَّاءَ وَأَنْ تَصْبِرُوا عَنْ نِكَاحِ الْإِمَاءِ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَهُوَ حَلَالٌ»
Edition record 371972 · p. 272Link to report ↗

“But those who follow [their] passions desire”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:27).

26
Explanation from Mujāhid 26

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
But those who follow [their] passions desire [al-Nisa 27], meaning: "the fornicators, that you deviate," he says: "that you commit fornication."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
وَيُرِيدُ الَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ الشَّهَوَاتِ [النساء: 27] يَعْنِي: «الزُّنَاةَ أَنْ تَمِيلُوا» ، يَقُولُ: «أَنْ تَزْنُوا»

“If you avoid the major sins which you are forbidden”

Explanation from Mujāhid 28

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording

20

“And do not wish for that by which God has made some of you exceed…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:32).

29
Explanation from Mujāhid 29

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And do not wish for that by which God has made some of you exceed others [al-Nisa 32], he said: ⦗p. 274⦘ "This is the saying of the women: 'If only we were men, so we could fight and attain what they attain.'" So there was revealed: And do not wish for that by which God has made some of you exceed others [al-Nisa 32].
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: فِي قَوْلِهِ
وَلَا تَتَمَنَّوْا مَا فَضَّلَ اللَّهُ بِهِ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ [النساء: 32] قَالَ: ⦗ص: 274⦘ «هَذَا قَوْلُ النِّسَاءِ لَيْتَنَا كُنَّا رِجَالًا فَنَغْزُوَ، وَنَبْلُغَ مَا بَلَغُوا» فَنَزَلَتْ وَلَا تَتَمَنَّوْا مَا فَضَّلَ اللَّهُ بِهِ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ [النساء: 32]
Edition record 371976 · p. 273Link to report ↗

“and those with whom your oaths have made a bond, give them their…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:33).

30
Explanation from Mujāhid 30

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

“Men are in charge of women”

Four explanations transmitted from al-Ḥasan, Mujāhid ibn Jabr, Ibrāhīm and al-Shaʿbī (Q 4:34).

31
Explanation from al-Ḥasan 31

al-Ḥasan

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: al-Mubarak ibn Fudala related to us, from al-Hasan; and Abu Jafar al-Razi, from Yunus ibn Ubayd, from al-Hasan; and Hammad ibn Salama, from Yunus ibn Ubayd, from al-Hasan, who said:
A man slapped his wife, and she came to the Prophet ﷺ. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Retaliation is due to her against her husband." Then revelation came to the Prophet ﷺ and there was revealed to him: Men are in charge of women [al-Nisa 34] to the end of the verse. The Messenger of God ﷺ recited it to them and said: "We wanted one thing and God wanted another, and what God, Mighty and Majestic, wants is best." In the report of Hammad ibn Salama: a man wounded his wife.
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، وَأَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الرَّازِيُّ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، وَحَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ: لَطَمَ رَجُلٌ امْرَأَتَهُ فَأَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ:
«لِزَوْجِهَا الْقِصَاصُ» فَأُنْزِلَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ الْوَحْيُ، وَنَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ الرِّجَالُ قَوَّامُونَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ [النساء: 34] إِلَى آخِرِ الْآيَةِ، فَقَرَأَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَقَالَ: «أَرَدْنَا أَمْرًا وَأَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَمْرًا غَيْرَهُ، وَمَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ عز وجل خَيْرٌ» . وَفِي حَدِيثِ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ جَرَحَ رَجُلٌ امْرَأَتَهُ

40
Explanation from Mujāhid 40

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
The Shaykh, the Imam, the scholar, the trustworthy Abu Mansur Muhammad ibn Abd al-Malik ibn al-Hasan ibn Khayrun ؒ informed us, by recitation to him while I listened, and he acknowledged it in Rajab of the year five hundred and thirty-eight, saying: My paternal uncle, the upright Abu al-Fadl Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Khayrun informed us, by recitation to him while I listened, and he acknowledged it in Shawwal of the year four hundred and eighty-two, saying: Abu Ali al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn Ibrahim ibn al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Shadhan informed us, by recitation to him, saying: Abu al-Qasim Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Ubayd al-Qadi al-Hamadhani informed us, by recitation to him, saying: Ibrahim ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali al-Kisai related to us; Adam ibn Abi Iyas related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words
Among those who are Jews are some who distort words from their places [al-Nisa 46], meaning: "the Jews' alteration of the Torah."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا الشَّيْخُ الْإِمَامُ الْعَالِمُ الثِّقَةُ أَبُو مَنْصُورٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ خَيْرُونَ رحمه الله، قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ فَأَقَرَّ بِهِ فِي رَجَبٍ مِنْ سَنَةِ ثَمَانٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ وَخَمْسِمِائَةٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمِّي الْعَدْلُ أَبُو الْفَضْلِ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ خَيْرُونَ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ فَأَقَرَّ بِهِ فِي شَوَّالٍ مِنْ سَنَةِ اثْنَتَيْنِ وَثَمَانِينَ وَأَرْبَعِمِائَةٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ، قَالَ: أَنْبَا أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ القَاضِي الْهَمَذَانِيِّ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْكِسَائِيُّ، ثنا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ
مِنَ الَّذِينَ هَادُوا يُحَرِّفُونَ الْكَلِمَ عَنْ مَوَاضِعِهِ [النساء: 46] يَعْنِي: «تَبْدِيلَ الْيَهُوَدِ التَّوْرَاةَ»

“Or do they envy people for what God has given them of His bounty?”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:54, 4:55).

52
Explanation from Mujāhid 52

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
"Or do they envy people for what God has given them of His bounty? [al-Nisa 54]" "They are the enemies of God, the Jews, who envied Muhammad ﷺ." God says: "Then We had already given the family of Abraham the Scripture and wisdom [al-Nisa 54]," "and they [the Jews] are not of them"; "and We gave them a great kingdom [al-Nisa 54]," "meaning prophethood"; "and among them were those who believed in him [al-Nisa 55]," "meaning among them were those who believed in what was revealed to Muhammad, meaning among the Jews"; "and among them were those who turned away from him [al-Nisa 55]."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
" أَمْ يَحْسُدُونَ النَّاسَ عَلَى مَا آتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ [النساء: 54] «وَهُمْ أَعْدَاءُ اللَّهِ، الْيَهُوَدُ، حَسَدُوا مُحَمَّدًا ﷺ» . يَقُولُ اللَّهُ: فَقَدْ آتَيْنَا آلَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ [النساء: 54] «وَلَيْسُوا مِنْهُمْ» ، وَآتَيْنَاهُمْ مُلْكًا عَظِيمًا [النساء: 54] «يَعْنِي النُّبُوَّةَ» ، فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ آمَنَ بِهِ [النساء: 55] «يَعْنِي مِنْهُمْ مَنْ آمَنَ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ يَعْنِي مِنَ الْيَهُوَدِ» وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ صَدَّ عَنْهُ [النساء: 55]
Edition record 371999 · p. 284Link to report ↗

“They wish to refer legal judgment to the taghut”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:60).

56
Explanation from Mujāhid 56

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
A man of the hypocrites and a man of the Jews disputed. The Jew said: "Come with us to Muhammad." The hypocrite said: "Come with us to Kab ibn al-Ashraf." So God revealed: They wish to refer legal judgment to the taghut [al-Nisa 60], "and he is Kab ibn al-Ashraf."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: تَنَازَعَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَرَجُلٌ مِنَ الْيَهُوَدِ فَقَالَ الْيَهُوَدِيُّ: اذْهَبْ بِنَا إِلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَقَالَ الْمُنَافِقُ: اذْهَبْ بِنَا إِلَى كَعْبِ بْنِ الْأَشْرَفِ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ:
يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يَتَحَاكَمُوا إِلَى الطَّاغُوتِ [النساء: 60] «وَهُوَ كَعْبُ بْنُ الْأَشْرَفِ»

40

“Why are you two parties concerning the hypocrites”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:88, 4:90, 4:91).

69
Explanation from Mujāhid 69

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Why are you two parties concerning the hypocrites [al-Nisa 88], he said: "They are people who left Mecca and came to Medina claiming to be emigrating, and then apostatized after that. They asked permission of the Prophet ﷺ to go to Mecca to bring goods of theirs. The believers differed about them: some said, 'They are of us,' and some said, 'They are hypocrites.' So God, Mighty and Majestic, made clear their condition and commanded fighting them. They came with their goods, heading for Hilal ibn Uwaymir al-Aslami, who had an alliance with the Prophet ﷺ." And on His words their hearts constrict [al-Nisa 90]: He says: "his heart was constricted," he says: "his heart was constricted from fighting the believers or fighting his people, defending them, because they were heading for Hilal, who had a treaty with the Prophet ﷺ." Then He said: You will find others who wish to obtain security from you and security from their people [al-Nisa 91]: "They are people of the people of Mecca who used to come to the Prophet ﷺ and profess Islam to be seen, then return to their people and relapse into idolatry, wishing by that to be safe here and there. The Prophet ﷺ ordered fighting them if they did not withdraw."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
فَمَا لَكُمْ فِي الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِئَتَيْنِ [النساء: 88] قَالَ: " هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَرَجُوا مِنْ مَكَّةَ حَتَّى قَدِمُوا الْمَدِينَةَ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُهَاجِرُونَ، ثُمَّ ارْتَدُّوا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَاسْتَأْذَنُوا النَّبِيَّ ﷺ إِلَى مَكَّةَ لِيَأْتُوا بِبِضَائِعَ لَهُمْ، فَاخْتَلَفَ فِيهِمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: هُمْ مِنَّا، وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: هُمْ مُنَافِقُونَ، فَبَيَّنَ اللَّهُ عز وجل حَالَهُمْ، وَأَمَرَ بِقِتَالِهِمْ، فَجَاءُوا بِبِضَائِعِهِمْ يُرِيدُونَ هِلَالَ بْنَ عُوَيْمِرٍ الْأَسْلَمِيَّ، وَكَانَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حِلْفٌ ". وَفِي قَوْلِهِ حَصِرَتْ صُدُورُهُمْ [النساء: 90] يَقُولُ: «حَصِرَ صَدْرُهُ» يَقُولُ: «ضَاقَ صَدْرُهُ أَنْ يُقَاتِلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَوْ يُقَاتِلَ قَوْمَهُ يُدَافِعُ عَنْهُمْ بِأَنَّهُمْ يَؤُمُّونَ هِلَالًا وَبَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ عَهْدٌ» . ثُمَّ قَالَ: سَتَجِدُونَ آخَرِينَ يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يَأْمَنُوكُمْ وَيَأْمَنُوا قَوْمَهُمْ [النساء: 91] «وَهُمْ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ كَانُوا يَأْتُونَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ، فَيُسْلِمُونَ رِيَاءً، ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُونَ إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ، وَيَرْتَكِسُونَ فِي الْأَوْثَانِ، وَيُرِيدُونَ بِذَلِكَ أَنْ يَأْمَنُوا هَهُنَا وَهَهُنَا، فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِقِتَالِهِمْ إِنْ لَمْ يَعْتَزِلُوا»
Edition record 372016 · p. 288Link to report ↗
70
Explanation from Mujāhid 70

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
"Ayyash ibn Abi Rabia became Muslim and emigrated to the Prophet ﷺ. Abu ⦗p. 289⦘ Jahl ibn Hisham, who was his maternal brother, came to him with another man and said to him: 'Your mother adjures you by her kinship and right to return to her,' and she was Asma bint Makhrama. He went with the two of them, and they tied him up until they brought him to Mecca, where they tortured him. When the disbelievers saw them, it increased them in disbelief and temptation, and they said: 'Abu Jahl is able to do what he wishes to Muhammad ﷺ and to seize his companions.' The man who was with Abu Jahl became Muslim, and Ayyash killed him without knowing of his Islam." So God, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: It is not for a believer to kill a believer except by mistake [al-Nisa 92].
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" أَسْلَمَ عَيَّاشُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ وَهَاجَرَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، فَجَاءَهُ أَبُو ⦗ص: 289⦘ جَهْلِ بْنُ هِشَامٍ وَهُوَ أَخُوهُ لِأُمِّهِ، وَرَجُلٌ آخَرُ مَعَهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: إِنَّ أُمَّكَ تُنَاشِدُكَ رَحِمَهَا وَحَقَّهَا أَنْ تَرْجِعَ إِلَيْهَا، وَهِيَ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ مَخْرَمَةَ فَأَقْبَلَ مَعَهُمَا فَرَبَطَاهُ حَتَّى قَدِمَا بِهِ مَكَّةَ، فَكَانَا يُعَذِّبَانِهِ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُمَا الْكُفَّارُ زَادَهُمْ ذَلِكَ كُفْرًا وَافْتِتَانًا، وَقَالُوا: إِنَّ أَبَا جَهْلٍ لَيَقْدِرُ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ عَلَى مَا شَاءَ وَيَأْخُذُ أَصْحَابَهُ، فَأَسْلَمَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي كَانَ مَعَ أَبِي جَهْلٍ، فَقَتَلَهُ عَيَّاشٌ، وَلَا يَعْلَمُ بِإِسْلَامِهِ "، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عز وجل وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ أَنْ يَقْتُلَ مُؤْمِنًا إِلَّا خَطَأً

“and do not say to one who gives you greetings of peace, 'You are…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:94).

71
Explanation from Mujāhid 71

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
"Muslims met a shepherd, who said to them: 'Peace be upon you; I am a believer.' They did not accept that from him, killed him, and took his sheep." So there was revealed concerning them: and do not say to one who gives you greetings of peace, 'You are not a believer' [al-Nisa 94].
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" لَقِيَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ رَاعِيَ غَنَمٍ فَقَالَ لَهُمُ: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنِّي مُؤْمِنٌ، فَلَمْ يَقْبَلُوا ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ، فَقَتَلُوهُ وَأَخَذُوا غَنَمَهُ "، فَنَزَلَ فِيهِمْ وَلَا تَقُولُوا لِمَنْ أَلْقَى إِلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامَ لَسْتَ مُؤْمِنًا [النساء: 94]

42

“Indeed, those whom the angels take in death while wronging…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:97, 4:98, 4:99).

72
Explanation from Mujāhid 72

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Indeed, those whom the angels take in death while wronging themselves [al-Nisa 97], meaning: "those of the weak disbelievers of Quraysh who were killed at Badr"; except for the oppressed among men, women, and children who cannot devise a plan nor are directed to a way [al-Nisa 98]: "They are believers who had been oppressed in Mecca. The Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'They are in the position of those who were killed at Badr from the weak of ⦗p. 290⦘ Quraysh.'" So it was revealed concerning them: who cannot devise a plan nor are directed to a way [al-Nisa 98], "meaning a path"; those, it is expected that God will pardon them [al-Nisa 99].
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ ظَالِمِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ [النساء: 97] يَعْنِي: «مَنْ قُتِلَ مِنْ ضُعَفَاءِ كُفَّارِ قُرَيْشٍ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ» ، إِلَّا الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ وَالْوِلْدَانِ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ حِيلَةً وَلَا يَهْتَدُونَ سَبِيلًا [النساء: 98] " وَهُمْ مُؤْمِنُونَ كَانُوا مُسْتَضْعَفِينَ بِمَكَّةَ، فَقَالَ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ: هُمْ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا بِبَدْرٍ مِنْ ضُعَفَاءِ ⦗ص: 290⦘ قُرَيْشٍ "، فَنَزَلَ فِيهِمْ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ حِيلَةً وَلَا يَهْتَدُونَ سَبِيلًا [النساء: 98] «يَعْنِي طَرِيقًا» ، فَأُولَئِكَ عَسَى اللَّهُ أَنْ يَعْفُوَ عَنْهُمْ [النساء: 99]

44

“there is no blame upon you for shortening the prayer”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:101, 4:102).

75
Explanation from Mujāhid 75

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
there is no blame upon you for shortening the prayer [al-Nisa 101]: "That was the day when the Prophet ﷺ was at Usfan and the enemy at Dajnan. The Messenger of God ﷺ led his companions in the noon prayer, four rak'as, with their bowing, prostrating, standing, and sitting all together. The polytheists intended to raid their baggage and belongings when they stood for the afternoon prayer." So God, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: And when you are among them and lead them in prayer, let a party of them stand with you [al-Nisa 102] to the end of the verse. "The Messenger of God ﷺ arranged his companions behind him in two rows, then ⦗p. 291⦘ said the takbir, and they all said the takbir. Then the first row prostrated with the Prophet's prostration while the others stood. Then the others prostrated. Then he said the takbir with them and they all said the takbir. The other row moved forward and the first row moved back, and they took turns in prostration as they did the first time. And the afternoon prayer was shortened to two rak'as."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَنْ تَقْصُرُوا مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ [النساء: 101] «وَذَلِكَ يَوْمَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِعُسْفَانَ، وَالْعَدُوُّ بِضَجْنَانَ، فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِأَصْحَابِهِ الظُّهْرَ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ، رُكُوعَهُمْ وَسُجُودَهُمْ وَقِيَامَهُمْ وَقُعُودَهُمْ مَعًا جَمِيعًا، فَهَمَّ بِهِمُ الْمُشْرِكُونَ أَنْ يُغِيرُوا عَلَى أَمْتِعَتِهِمْ وَأَثْقَالِهِمْ إِذَا قَامُوا لِلْعَصْرِ» ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عز وجل وَإِذَا كُنْتَ فِيهِمْ فَأَقَمْتَ لَهُمُ الصَّلَاةَ فَلْتَقُمْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ مَعَكَ [النساء: 102] إِلَى آخِرِ الْآيَةِ. «فَصَفَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَصْحَابَهُ خَلْفَهُ صَفَّيْنِ، ثُمَّ ⦗ص: 291⦘ كَبَّرَ بِهِمْ وَكَبَّرُوا جَمِيعًا، ثُمَّ سَجَدَ الْأَوَّلُونَ بِسُجُودِ النَّبِيِّ، وَالْآخَرُونَ قِيَامٌ، ثُمَّ سَجَدَ الْآخَرُونَ، ثُمَّ كَبَّرَ بِهِمْ وَكَبَّرُوا جَمِيعًا، فَتَقَدَّمَ الصَّفُّ الْآخَرُ وَاسْتَأْخَرَ الصَّفُّ الْأَوَّلُ، فَتَعَاقَبُوا السُّجُودَ كَمَا فَعَلُوا أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ، وَقَصُرَتْ صَلَاةُ الْعَصْرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ»

84
Explanation from Mujāhid 84

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
concerning the orphan women to whom you do not give what is decreed for them [al-Nisa 127], he said: "The people of the pre-Islamic period did not apportion anything to women or boys, saying: 'They do not fight and bring no benefit.' So God, Mighty and Majestic, prescribed inheritance for them." Then He said: ⦗p. 294⦘ and you desire to marry them [al-Nisa 127]. He said: "Let a man be generous with the wealth of an orphan girl if he has no good deed of his own; and they were commanded to deal with the orphan with justice [qist]," meaning with fairness.

الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فِي يَتَامَى النِّسَاءِ اللَّاتِي لَا تُؤْتُونَهُنَّ مَا كُتِبَ لَهُنَّ [النساء: 127] قَالَ: " كَانَ أَهْلُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ لَا يَقْسِمُونَ لِلنِّسَاءِ وَلَا لِلصِّبْيَانِ شَيْئًا، يَقُولُونَ: إِنَّهُمْ لَا يَغْزُونَ، وَلَا يُغَنُونَ خَيْرًا، فَفَرَضَ اللَّهُ عز وجل لَهُمُ الْمِيرَاثَ "، ثُمَّ قَالَ: ⦗ص: 294⦘ وَتَرْغَبُونَ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوهُنَّ [النساء: 127] فَقَالَ: «لِيَنْفُسْ رَجُلٌ فِي مَالِ يَتِيمةٍ إِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ حَسَنَةٌ، وَأُمِرُوا لِلْيَتِيمِ بِالْقِسْطِ يَعْنِي بِالْعَدْلِ»

“And if a woman fears from her husband ill-treatment or aversion…”

Two explanations transmitted from Khālid ibn ʿArʿara and Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:128, 4:129).

85
Explanation from Khālid ibn ʿArʿara 85

Khālid ibn ʿArʿara

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Simak ibn Harb, from Khalid ibn Arara, who said:
I heard Ali ibn Abi Talib ﷺ say on the words of God, Mighty and Majestic: And if a woman fears from her husband ill-treatment or aversion, there is no blame upon them if they make terms of settlement between themselves [al-Nisa 128], he said: "It is a man who has two wives, one of whom has become old or is plain, and he wants to part from her; so she makes terms with him that he spend one night with her and many nights with the other, without separating from her. Whatever she is content with, there is no harm in it; and if she goes back on it, he must treat them equally."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَرْعَرَةَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عليه السلام، يَقُولُ فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل:
وَإِنِ امْرَأَةٌ خَافَتْ مِنْ بَعْلِهَا نُشُوزًا [النساء: 128] أَوْ إِعْرَاضًا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا أَنْ يُصْلِحَا بَيْنَهُمَا صُلْحًا، قَالَ: «هُوَ الرَّجُلُ يَكُونُ عِنْدَهُ امْرَأَتَانِ فَتَكُونُ إِحْدَاهُمَا قَدْ عَجَزَتْ، أَوْ تَكُونُ دَمِيمَةً، فَيُرِيدُ فَرَاقَهَا، فَتُصَالِحُهُ عَلَى أَنْ يَكُونَ عِنْدَهَا لَيْلَةً، وَعِنْدَ الْأُخْرَى لَيَالِيَ، وَلَا يُفَارِقُهَا فَمَا طَابَتْ بِهِ نَفْسُهَا فَلَا بَأْسَ بِهِ، فَإِنْ رَجَعَتْ سَوَّى بَيْنَهُمَا»
Edition record 372032 · p. 294Link to report ↗
86
Explanation from Mujāhid 86

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
"This concerns a man who has an older wife and says to her: 'You are old, and I want to replace you with a young wife. If you wish, stay for your child's sake and I will apportion you something of myself.' If she agrees, that is the settlement of which God, Mighty and Majestic, said: and settlement is best [al-Nisa 128]; it was revealed about Abu al-Sanabil ibn Bakak. Then He said: And you will never be able to be equal between wives, even if you are keen to do so [al-Nisa 129], meaning in love, 'so do not incline completely,' He says: do not deliberately do wrong."

الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فَبِظُلْمٍ مِنَ الَّذِينَ هَادُوا حَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ طَيِّبَاتٍ أُحِلَّتْ لَهُمْ وَبِصَدِّهِمْ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ كَثِيرًا [النساء: 160] يَقُولُ: «بِمَا صَدُّوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَغَيْرَهُمْ عَنِ الْحَقِّ»

62

“A proof has come to you from your Lord”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:174).

98
Explanation from Mujāhid 98

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
A proof has come to you from your Lord [al-Nisa 174], meaning: "a clear argument."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ بُرْهَانٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ [النساء: 174] يَعْنِي: «حُجَّةً»
